children: MON, FF, XPL and other tokens are scheduled for large unlocks next week, with MON’s release valued at about $219 million. According to PANews, citing Token Unlocks data, Monad (MON) is expected to unlock about 16.6 billion tokens at 10 p.m. on November 24, equal to 32.37% of its circulating supply. Falcon Finance (FF) is scheduled to unlock about 209 million tokens at 9 p.m. on November 29, or 6.21% of its circulating supply, valued at about $21.1 million. Plasma (XPL) is set to unlock about 228 million tokens at 8 p.m. (UTC+8) on November 25, equal to 4.78% of its circulating supply and valued at about $10.4 million. SoSoValue (SOSO) is expected to release about 23.46 million tokens at 5 p.m. on November 24, or 5.33% of its circulating supply, valued at about $6.1 million. SOON (SOON) is scheduled to unlock about 20.24 million tokens at 4:30 p.m. on November 23, equal to 3.38% of its circulating supply and valued at about $5.3 million. Huma Finance (HUMA) is set to unlock about 459 million tokens at 9 p.m. (UTC+8) on November 26, or 14.31% of its circulating supply, valued at about $3.9 million. ChainOpera AI (COAI) is expected to unlock about 19.55 million tokens at 3 p.m. on November 25, equal to 5.98% of its circulating supply and valued at about $3.4 million. Humanity (H) is scheduled to unlock about 266 million tokens at 8 a.m. on November 25, or 6.40% of its circulating supply, valued at about $3 million.

title: MON, FF, XPL and Other Tokens Set for Large Unlocks Next Week; MON Unlock Valued at $219 Million
